  Your new company  
 You'll be working with one of Australia's largest local government organisations, supporting critical infrastructure and assets that directly impact the community. 
   
  Your new role  
  Key Responsibilities   
 
 Lead / support detailed design and configuration discussions; specifying details to configure SAP Plant Maintenance Module and its key elements such as Master Data, Transactional Data, Field Mobility and Scheduling. 
 Conduct thorough testing of SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) configurations to identify and resolve any issues or discrepancies 
 Collaborate with peers in the ERP program/platform team to ensure services are co-ordinated and integrated. 
 Collaborate with business and vendors to ensure PP processes and system configurations are fit for purpose against Council's requirements. 
 
  What you'll need to succeed   Mandatory requirements:  
 
 At least 1 full S/4HANA greenfield implementation experience. 
 Demonstrated experience of working in a business function related to Enterprise Asset Management (EAM). 
 Tertiary qualification in a relevant or related discipline. 
 
   
  Required skills and experience:  
 
 Highly skilled in SAP Plant Maintenance 
 Strong communication and collaboration skills 
 At least 8 years of experience in successful implementation or conversion projects in EAM 
 Certification in SAP PM is highly desirable. 
 Demonstrate experience of EAM integration with other modules such as Material Management (MM), Sales and Finance (FICO) 
 Exceptional stakeholder engagement, influencing and management skills - understanding how others think and act - ability to smoothly deliver outcomes through strong business, team, and supplier partnerships. 
 
   
  What you'll get in return  
 
 Opportunity to work on a significant SAP S/4HANA transformation program. 
 Exposure to complex Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) and Plant Maintenance processes. 
 Ability to influence the future-state solution rather than simply supporting an existing environment. 
 End-to-end project involvement including design, testing, deployment and continuous improvement.

result.description:
Office Manager- Full Time 
Bharter Pty Ltd
11 View Rd, Epping VIC 3076
ABN 64 630 831 293
79,000-81,000 AUD plus superannuation 
About Us 
Bharter Pty Ltd is a leading transport and logistics company, providing reliable and customized solutions for businesses worldwide. We provide multimodal freight solutions including air, sea, and road transport, cold chain logistics, interstate linehaul, warehousing, and packaging services across metro Melbourne and interstate routes.
Our operations handle diverse cargo types from small parcels to palletized freight, refrigerated goods, and oversized commercial shipments, serving both luxury retail clients and local businesses with customized 3PL solutions.
Job Duties – Office Manager
• Contribute to the planning, coordination and continuous review of office services across transport, warehousing and logistics operations, and establish service standards to support efficient business performance
• Allocate and manage office resources, including staff, workspace and equipment, to ensure optimal utilisation in a fast-paced logistics environment
• Assign work to administrative and operational support staff, monitor performance, and ensure timely completion of tasks in line with business priorities
• Oversee the management of office records, documentation and accounts, including freight documentation, service records, and internal reporting systems
• Ensure office equipment, systems and supplies are maintained and functioning effectively to support day-to-day logistics and administrative operations
• Monitor and ensure compliance with workplace health and safety requirements within the office and administrative functions of the business
• Ensure all office operations comply with relevant government legislation, policies and procedures, including those applicable to transport, logistics and workplace practices
• Coordinate personnel activities, including recruitment support, onboarding, staff scheduling, performance monitoring, payroll coordination, and training administration
• Support senior management in implementing administrative systems, improving workflow processes, and enhancing overall operational efficiency
• Maintain effective communication channels across departments to support coordination of freight operations, client servicing and administrative functions
• Oversee warehouse operations, manage transport operations and driver scheduling to ensure timely deliveries and compliance with safety regulations. Establish and maintain strong internal and external relationships to support smooth office operations and contribute to overall business performance

Skills, Qualifications, and Experience Required
•	Associate degree or advance diploma with at least one year of relevant experience
•	Excellent communication, analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with the ability to support a fast-paced logistics and transport environment and build effective working relationships across teams

If you are a proactive and results-driven individual with a passion for office management, we invite you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Please submit your resume and cover letter outlining your relevant experience and qualifications. We look forward to reviewing your application.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Your Role as Finance Business Partner

As a Finance Business Partner, you'll work closely with operational leaders to deliver financial insights, performance analysis and strategic advice that supports informed decision-making.

You will play a key role in ensuring strong financial management across both corporate and service delivery functions, contributing to business sustainability, innovation and growth.

Key responsibilities include:

Partner with leaders to provide financial advice and insights that support informed decision-making.

Develop financial models, scenario analysis and cost-benefit assessments to evaluate strategic opportunities.

Turn complex financial and operational data into clear, practical recommendations.

Support business planning, performance reviews and investment decisions with trusted financial guidance.

Lead budgeting and forecasting activities, ensuring forecasts are accurate, evidence-based and aligned with organisational goals.

Prepare monthly performance reports, including KPI tracking, variance analysis and key business insights.

Assist with business cases for new programs, service expansions and tender opportunities.

Improve financial systems, reporting and data quality while supporting compliance, audits and governance requirements.

What We Offer

Salary packaging benefits: boost your take-home pay by up to $18,550 annually through not-for-profit tax concessions

Wellbeing Support: Access discounts on private health insurance and gym memberships, and free, confidential counselling through our employee assistance program.

Flexible working: opportunities with hybrid (office-WFH) options

Your Opportunity
We are seeking talented individuals to join our External Audit practise at KPMG.  We are open to full-time/part-time/casual/max-term/flexible working options.

IT External Audit
Our IT External Audit team assists our clients to meet their IT External audit requirements and timelines. We work as an integrated business and as part of a larger multi-disciplinary team. The team draws on a diverse and dedicated group of people, powerful KPMG methodologies, innovating capability and assets, and global resources to support our clients in achieving the right milestones. 

Audit & Assurance: External Audit
Our Audit teams provide value to our clients by delivering specialised quality audit and assurance services. High-quality, independent financial statement audits are essential to maintaining investor confidence. Our audit professionals are committed to the public interest, challenging assumptions, and unlocking valuable insights based on a solid understanding of an organisation’s business and industry.

How are you extraordinary?
•	You are analytically minded and enjoy applying structured thinking and analysis techniques to complex problems. 
•	You are a kind and compassionate leader with a passion for continually growing your leadership skills to get the best out of a diverse and multidisciplinary team.
•	You are a people-person with a love of sharing your Audit and Assurance insight and tailoring your communication appropriately for subject matter experts and clients who want to learn more.

Your Experience
To be considered for this opportunity, your qualifications, skills & experience could include:

IT External Audit
•	Experience in assisting clients meet their IT External audit requirements and timelines.
•	Supporting engagements in the preparation of clear and concise IT External Audit reports. 
•	Providing technical knowledge, direction, and training to engagement team members.
•	In a leadership role, manage small teams and oversee the planning and execution of IT External Audit client engagements
•	Supporting business proposals and business development activities by assisting in the identification of new target clients, building business relationships, and developing/presenting proposals/findings
•	An innovative mindset and passion for problem solving enabled through technology.

Audit & Assurance: External Audit
•	Experience leading, managing and executing advisory related engagements of high-profile clients and all aspects of audit delivery, client service and business development.
•	Providing technical knowledge, direction, and training to engagement team members.
•	Experience working across Private and Corporate clients is desired.
•	Qualifications in CA/CPA and CISA/CISM/CRISC, and strong IFRS skills, will be viewed favourably.

Please note, the salary ranges $60k - $100k+ with respect to your level of experience.
